title: Guest Bloggers
author: Kenney Jacob
content:
Domestic Avalanche writes about the Society, Politics and International Issues with a libertarian point of view. An engineer by training and an analyst by profession, Domestic Avalanche is extremely keen on observing people's behavior under flux. Aided with extensive research and a sharp language, Domestic Avalanche is unafraid to broach subjects that are controversial or taboo for many people.

Anand Subramanian, Blogger. Known online as TheAnand, he is a prolific blogger who blogs about making money online, SEO, wordpress and more. He summarizes his life as âLife = Bucks + Benz + Babes. â

You guessed right - another guy with very little hair on his head. Jyothi M John - also known as JMJ works for the Computer Hardware Manufacturing and Distribution Industry. A very keen observer - he is passionate about technology. JMJ's idea of life - "there is always a solution to a problem"

Lucifer was an angel who was kicked out of heaven when he questioned God. He is here to question our country, our culture, our beliefs, our thinking and above all ourselves. A satire with a pinch of salt at the end!

Jithin "Jr" Krishnan More commonly known as just "Jr". (Supposed)Student of English literature. Victim of unnecessary exposure to Mallu culture and tradition. And hence has decided to go on a rampage against what seems odd and unrighteous. Volunteer of Cochin based youth voluntary network, Make A Difference. The Nomad, as the name suggests, doesn't stay at one place for a long time. While rolling stone gathers no moss, its also true that traveling opens up a whole new world of cultures, languages and people. The Nomad definitely has been humbled by all that he's seen as a result of this. Though his work may not be truly enlightening, it sure does bring out certain subtle points and practices in our society- both progressive and derogatory in nature. Do follow the Nomad's column for some bold writing!
